verdict.rationale: Segment's own Data Storage Destinations let you store your raw Segment data in data warehouses, AWS S3 and Google Cloud Storage. The Profile API also lets you programmatically read whole user and account objects, including external_ids, traits and events. That gives a documented path to get event and profile data out, but no evidence shows the export formats are open or that it covers all workspace data needed to leave. Missing for 10: explicit open-format guarantees (e.g. JSON/Parquet/CSV), a documented complete-account export or offboarding flow, coverage of non-event data such as audiences and configuration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
